evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet internals in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, RPC handling, and src/interfaces/wallet.h.
rationale: Extracts HD key derivation from RPC into CWallet and exposes it over interfaces::Wallet so the GUI can derive xpubs without RPC access. This directly unblocks the deriveHDKey component of the Multisig Wizard tracking issue (#35645).
